about_the_game:
Can One Gorilla Beat 100 Men?

Step into the fur of an unstoppable gorilla and answer the internet's most chaotic question. In this fast-paced, ragdoll-fueled arcade brawler, you're dropped into a nonstop brawl where men just keep coming—and your fists do the talking.

Smash, punch, and pummel your way through endless enemies in an over-the-top frenzy of physics and mayhem. Go for the classic 100-man challenge or see how long you can survive in unlimited mode. There are no waves, no breaks—just you, pure muscle, and a crowd of unlucky humans.

Simple, addictive gameplay makes it easy to pick up and hard to put down. Whether you're jumping in for a quick session or chasing high-body-count glory, it's pure, primal chaos from start to finish.

Key Features:

  • Customize Your Gorilla

Choose from a lineup of pre-made gorilla outfits — from a tank top muscle gorilla to a golden chain-wearing ape in purple pants. Pick your gorilla's fur and skin tone to match your favorite look. Every fight is yours to style.

  • Play as a gorilla in a hilarious brawler

  • Punch and pummel endless enemies in brutal, chaotic combat

  • Two modes: Beat 100 men or face an unlimited onslaught

  • Instant action, no fluff—just pure arcade fun

  • Ragdoll physics make every fight wild and unpredictable

  • Clear your rear with a hilarious fart-poop blast that sends foes flying behind you

  • Pound your chest to unleash a powerful shockwave, forcing all nearby enemies to step back

  • Highly re-playable with short, intense gameplay sessions

Can one gorilla beat 100 men? There’s only one way to find out.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti 4GB / AMD RX 560 4GB or equivalent
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: CPU: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU: NVIDIA RTX 2060 6GB / AMD RX 5700 or better
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

short_description: Can one gorilla beat 100 men? Step in, start swinging, and find out. Play as a gorilla in a chaotic ragdoll brawler where you punch, pummel, and try to survive. Go for 100 or push yourself in unlimited mode and see how long you last.
